m.e: Yeah, because we left late because you overslept.

m.t: Com quem dormiste depois de teres sido marcado.
m.e: Whom you slept with? After you'd been branded?

m.t: Dormiste com a minha melhor amiga, não consigo acreditar.
m.e: You slept with my best friend, I can't believe it.

m.t: Foste sim, quando dormiste com o meu pai.
m.e: Yeah, you did, when you slept with my dad.

m.t: Dormiste com ele e não sabes como se chama?
m.e: You slept with him and you don't know his name?

m.e: I'm pretty sure you slept with the spokesmodel.

m.e: Perhaps at some point you slept with one of her lovers.

m.t: É verdade, desde que dormiste com ela.
m.e: Oh, that's right, since you slept with her.

m.t: E ainda assim dormiste com ela.
m.e: Yet you slept with her.

m.t: Dormiste com a porra dum milionário!
m.e: You fucking slept with a billionaire.

m.t: Porque dormiste com ele?
m.e: Why'd you sleep with him?

m.t: - Sei que dormiste comigo.
m.e: I know you slept with me.

m.t: Não podes estar cansada quando dormiste na minha cama.
m.e: Hey, you don't get to act tired when you got a full night's sleep in my bed.

m.t: Pois é. Não dormiste muito ontem à noite, pois não?
m.e: That's right, you didn't get much sleep last night, did you?

m.e: You got drunk and slept in that bathroom.

m.t: Não me digas que dormiste aqui.
m.e: Don't tell me you slept here.

m.e: So... which governor did you sleep with?

m.e: - Hey, buddy, how'd you sleep?
